notice: Starting register of key laws and standards for each country. The list is a guide, not legal advice. Verify the current text, applicability and your own obligations with the regulator, your legal adviser or your client before audit use. Laws change.

india.title: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
india.scope: Consolidates the OSH laws for factories, construction, mines, docks and other establishments (verify current status)
duties: Provide a safe workplace and safe systems of work
Provide PPE, training and health surveillance as required
Report accidents and dangerous occurrences
india.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment / state labour departments

india.title: Factories Act 1948 and state Factories Rules
duties: Fence dangerous machinery (s.21)
Examine hoists and lifting machines (s.28 and s.29)
Control pressure plant (s.31), dangerous fumes (s.36) and fire (s.38)
india.authority: State Directorate of Factories / Industrial Safety and Health

india.title: Building and Other Construction Workers Act 1996 and Central Rules 1998
duties: Safe scaffolds, excavation, work at height and lifting
Safety committees and safety officers on larger sites
Welfare facilities

india.title: Manufacture, Storage and Import of Hazardous Chemicals Rules 1989
india.scope: Major accident hazard installations and hazardous chemicals (verify current status)
duties: Notify and prepare on-site emergency plans
Safety data sheets and labelling
Safety reports for major hazard sites
india.authority: State Pollution Control Board / Factories Inspectorate

india.title: CEA (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations and Indian Electricity Rules
duties: Safe installation, earthing and periodic inspection
Authorised persons only for electrical work

india.title: Indian Boilers Act 1923 and Boiler Regulations
india.scope: Boilers and steam pipes (verify current status)
duties: Registered boilers with a valid certificate
Competent boiler attendants

india.title: Static and Mobile Pressure Vessels (Unfired) Rules 1981 and Gas Cylinders Rules 2016
india.scope: Pressure vessels and gas cylinders (verify current status)
duties: Licence for storage and filling
Periodic testing of cylinders and vessels

india.title: Explosives Act 1884, Explosives Rules 2008 and Petroleum Rules 2002
india.scope: Explosives and petroleum storage (verify current status)
duties: Licences for storage, transport and use
Safe distances and fire precautions

india.title: Employees' Compensation Act 1923 and Employees' State Insurance Act 1948
india.scope: Injury compensation and social security (verify current status)
duties: Pay compensation for work injury
Register and insure eligible employees

india.title: National Building Code of India 2016 Part 4 (Fire and Life Safety)
india.scope: Fire safety design and means of escape (verify current status)
duties: Fire exits, alarms, extinguishers and hydrants as per occupancy
Periodic fire drills

india.title: Environment (Protection) Act 1986 and Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules 2016
india.scope: Environmental protection and waste (verify current status)
duties: Consent to operate and waste manifests
Safe storage and disposal of hazardous waste

india.title: ISO 45001:2018 Occupational health and safety management systems
duties: Plan, do, check and act cycle
Worker participation and continual improvement

gulf.title: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
gulf.scope: Employment and worker protections (verify current status)
duties: Employer duties for safety, health and working conditions
Worker protection from hazards
gulf.authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE)

gulf.title: UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020 on occupational health and safety and labour accommodation
gulf.scope: OSH duties and worker accommodation (verify current status)
duties: Provide a safe workplace, PPE and training
Risk assessment and safe labour accommodation
Report work injuries

gulf.title: UAE Fire and Life Safety Code of Practice
gulf.scope: Fire protection, means of escape and fire systems (verify current status)
duties: Approved fire systems and certificates
Fire drills and trained wardens
gulf.authority: UAE Civil Defence / General Command of Civil Defence

gulf.title: UAE summer midday work ban (15 June to 15 September, 12:30 to 15:00)
gulf.scope: Outdoor work in the summer heat (verify current status) for the current year
duties: Stop outdoor work in the ban hours
Provide shade, water and cooling

gulf.title: Dubai Municipality Code of Construction Safety Practice and Abu Dhabi OSHAD System Framework
gulf.scope: Construction and Abu Dhabi OSH management (verify current status)
duties: Contractor safety management
Permit to work, work at height and lifting rules
gulf.authority: Dubai Municipality / Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre (OSHAD)

gulf.title: Saudi Labor Law and MHRSD occupational safety and health regulations
gulf.scope: Employment and OSH duties in Saudi Arabia (verify current status)
duties: Protect workers from hazards and heat
Provide PPE and training
Report injuries
gulf.authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)

gulf.title: Saudi Building Code (fire protection) and Saudi Civil Defence requirements
gulf.scope: Fire and life safety in buildings (verify current status)
duties: Approved fire systems and certificates
Evacuation plans and drills

gulf.title: Saudi midday work ban (15 June to 15 September, 12:00 to 15:00)
gulf.scope: Outdoor work in the summer heat (verify current status) for the current year
duties: Stop outdoor work in the ban hours
Provide shade and water

gulf.title: Qatar Labour Law No. 14 of 2004 and ministerial decisions on heat stress
gulf.scope: Employment and heat protection in Qatar (verify current status)
duties: Protect workers from heat and hazards
Outdoor work limits in summer (1 June to 15 September, 10:00 to 15:30)

gulf.title: Client HSE standards: ADNOC HSE Management System and Saudi Aramco engineering standards
gulf.scope: Contract requirements on oil and gas and large projects (verify current status)
duties: Permit to work, LOTO and contractor HSE management
Incident reporting and audits as the contract says

gulf.title: ISO 45001:2018 Occupational health and safety management systems
duties: Plan, do, check and act cycle
Worker participation and continual improvement

canada.title: Canada Labour Code Part II and Canada Occupational Health and Safety Regulations
duties: Hazard prevention program and workplace committees
Right to know, participate and refuse dangerous work
canada.authority: Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC) Labour Program

canada.title: Ontario Occupational Health and Safety Act and Regulations (Construction O. Reg. 213/91, Industrial Establishments Reg. 851)
duties: Employer, supervisor and worker duties
Joint health and safety committee or representative
Report critical injuries immediately
canada.authority: Ontario Ministry of Labour, Immigration, Training and Skills Development

canada.title: British Columbia Workers Compensation Act and OHS Regulation
duties: Prevent injury and disease
Formal OHS program and committee for larger sites

canada.title: Alberta Occupational Health and Safety Act, Regulation and Code
duties: Hazard assessment and control
Joint work site health and safety committee

canada.title: Quebec Act respecting occupational health and safety
duties: Prevention programs and committees
Worker right to refuse

canada.title: WHMIS 2015 under the Hazardous Products Act and Hazardous Products Regulations
canada.scope: Hazardous products at work (verify current status)
duties: Labels and safety data sheets
Worker education and training

canada.title: Transportation of Dangerous Goods Act and Regulations
canada.scope: Transport of dangerous goods (verify current status)
duties: Classification, labelling and documents
Trained persons

canada.title: CSA standards: Z1000, Z1001, Z460, Z462, Z259 series, Z94 series
canada.scope: Management, lockout, electrical safety, fall protection and PPE (verify current status)
duties: Use as recognised good practice and where referenced by regulation

canada.title: National Fire Code of Canada and provincial fire codes
canada.scope: Fire safety in buildings and operations (verify current status)
duties: Fire safety plans and drills
Inspect and maintain fire systems

canada.title: COR (Certificate of Recognition) audit standards
canada.scope: Voluntary safety audit program (verify current status)
duties: Documented safety management system audited by a certified auditor

canada.title: ISO 45001:2018 Occupational health and safety management systems
duties: Plan, do, check and act cycle

usa.title: Occupational Safety and Health Act of 1970 (General Duty Clause, Section 5(a)(1))
duties: Provide a workplace free of recognised serious hazards
Comply with OSHA standards
Workers have the right to a safe workplace and to report hazards

usa.title: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 General Industry standards
duties: Hazard Communication 1910.1200
Lockout/Tagout 1910.147
Permit-required confined spaces 1910.146
Respiratory protection 1910.134 and PPE 1910.132

usa.title: OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Construction standards
duties: Fall protection Subpart M
Scaffolds Subpart L
Excavations Subpart P
Cranes Subpart CC

usa.title: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 Recording and reporting occupational injuries and illnesses
usa.scope: Injury and illness records (verify current status)
duties: Keep OSHA 300 logs
Report a fatality within 8 hours and an in-patient hospitalisation, amputation or eye loss within 24 hours (1904.39)

usa.title: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 Process Safety Management of Highly Hazardous Chemicals
usa.scope: Process facilities above threshold quantities (verify current status)
duties: Process hazard analysis and management of change
Operating procedures, mechanical integrity and audits

usa.title: OSHA 29 CFR 1915, 1917 and 1918 (shipyards, marine terminals, longshoring)
duties: Confined space and hot work rules for ships
Fall protection and lifting rules for terminals

usa.title: NFPA 70E, 101, 10 and 51B
usa.scope: Electrical safety, life safety, extinguishers and hot work (verify current status)
duties: Recognised good practice referenced by OSHA and fire codes

usa.title: EPA regulations (RCRA hazardous waste, EPCRA Tier II reporting) and spill rules
duties: Hazardous waste management
Annual chemical inventory reports

usa.title: US DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR)
usa.scope: Transport of hazardous materials (verify current status)
duties: Shipping papers, labels and placards
Hazmat employee training

usa.title: State OSHA plans such as Cal/OSHA, Washington L&I and others
usa.scope: Employers in states with an approved state plan (verify current status)
duties: Follow the state rules, which may be stricter than federal rules
For example Cal/OSHA Section 3395 heat illness prevention

usa.title: ANSI/ASSP Z10 Occupational health and safety management systems
duties: Plan, do, check and act cycle

usa.title: ISO 45001:2018 Occupational health and safety management systems
duties: Plan, do, check and act cycle
